text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 24,536.6, up 2.4% on the day and 6.98% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 2.0% (5‑day gain 5.85%). Advances outpaced declines (311 vs 179) giving a breadth score of 49.6 in a neutral zone. The move was fairly broad, with 406 stocks advancing and 89 lagging, and the market stayed above its 20‑day, 50‑day and 200‑day moving averages for roughly half of the constituents.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) added INR 7,284 cr today, marking a sixth consecutive buying day, whereas Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 3,712 cr, extending a four‑day net outflow. Leading sectors were Infrastructure, Capital Markets, Pharma and Oil & Gas, while IT, Media and Private Bank stocks showed weakness. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.07 for Nifty, a max‑pain level near 23,800 and a call wall at 25,000, suggesting some resistance above the current price.

Watch the 23,701 P pivot and the 23,592 S1 support on the Nifty 50, as well as the 55,484 P and 55,229 S1 levels on Bank Nifty. A break below the Nifty support could test the 23,300 zone, while a sustained rally toward the 25,000 call wall may trigger fresh buying. Keep an eye on global crude trends and any earnings releases that could shift sector sentiment.
